eventDetail.scope: The IEEE Conference on Generative AI for Secure Systems (GAISS) is a premier forum dedicated to advancing research and innovation at the intersection of generative AI and cybersecurity. This conference brings together leading academics, industry professionals, and government agencies to discuss the transformative potential of generative AI in building, securing, and defending modern systems against evolving cyber threats.
